issues.reason: Measures & units states that 'a scale no word supplies is never invented — an unstated dimension takes the reserved slot symbol unspecified', and neither 'about one and a half vessels of mire-essence' nor 'eight weeks of winter supply' supplies the words quantity or duration.

The anchor half stands — 'twelve days away' is measured from the day-21 report, so (BeforeBy now sk_new_moon_1 12 day) records a distance from speech time that the text never states (and Past over a now-relation is self-cancelling) — but the licensing half is overstated, since Comparatives & degree explicitly wraps a relation atom from a copular clause in tense ('Alice was taller than Bob' -> (Past (More tall alice bob))).

Compound concepts suppresses the head genus when the IS-A fails ('a hot dog is not a dog'), and 'the next new moon' here denotes a lunar-phase occurrence still twelve days ahead — not a kind of moon, and not a thing of which 'is new' is predicable — so withholding (Inheritance new_moon moon) and the modifier genus is licensed rather than an omission.

gaps_confirmed: Measure-phrase / container of-phrase over a mass noun ('one and a half vessels of mire-essence', 'eight weeks of winter supply') has no licensed encoding: the genitive section excludes the measure 'of' ('a cup of water') and names no replacement, and the Measure fallback has no word to fill its scale slot.

A temporal-distance predication inside a seal whose reference point is the matrix event's time ('the next new moon was twelve days away'): ordering atoms may not cross a seal boundary, so the report event cannot anchor it, and the one licensed anchor (the speech-time constant now) is the wrong time.

'next' as a restrictive modifier on an entity NP ('the next new moon') has no licensed carrier — the 'next / last Tuesday' rule covers only time adverbials, where the clause's tense carries the direction, and Ordinal defines only first / a numeral / last.

A mandative subjunctive that-complement ('proposed that Coraline Ash join …') — a tenseless finite-shaped clause — is not addressed by Propositional attitudes, which assumes either a tensed finite clause or a to-infinitive control complement.
new_gaps: Day-of-year / era dating ('on day 21 of Year 1') has no well-formed term: (Day <n>) is the month-day slot that composes with (Month <name>), so (Day 21) reads as the 21st of an unstated month, and (Year 1) cannot be distinguished from a calendar year.
defect_summary: For the confirmed scale issue the compliant form is the reserved slot symbol — (Measure sk_mire_essence_1 unspecified (ParticleFromNormal 1.5 0.15) vessel), and likewise unspecified in place of duration on the supply measure — since no word in either clause supplies a dimension; for the standing half of the partial, NO compliant form is licensed: the distance is anchored on the matrix report's time, ordering atoms may not cross a seal boundary, and now is the only licensed anchor, so the clause should have been left unencoded with the gap recorded (filed above).
notes: Seal discipline, holder roles, projection of definite/named typing and compound genus atoms, and the embedded-'would' Future are all correct, so the parse fails on two narrow slot/anchor points rather than on structure. Both failures sit next to genuine coverage gaps, which is where the re-parse instruction set will have to move first.
